title: Scalding Water and Gardens of Silk

paragraphs.text: The zaqqum boils in the bellies of the sinful in the same way that scalding water boils and bubbles. Then a harsh command will be given about each of them: seize the sinner, drag him into the middle of Hellfire, and pour scalding water over his head as punishment. He will be told mockingly to taste it, because in the world he thought of himself as honored and noble. This, he will be reminded, is exactly the punishment he used to doubt and argue about during his life.

The righteous, in contrast, will be in a place of safety, among gardens and springs. They will wear clothes of fine silk and rich brocade, sitting face to face with one another. Allah will marry them to fair women with large, beautiful eyes. There they may ask for any kind of fruit they like, and it will be brought to them while they feel safe and secure. They will never taste death again after the first death, and Allah will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire. All this comes as a generous bounty from the Prophet's Lord, and it is truly the great success.

Allah has made the Qur'an easy to understand by sending it in the Prophet's own language, so that people might remember and take the lesson from it. So the Prophet is told to wait and watch what happens, because the disbelievers too are waiting and watching for his end.

Then a new surah begins with the letters Ha, Meem. The revelation of this Book comes from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise. Indeed, within the heavens and the earth there are many signs for those who truly believe.

to take hold of suddenly and firmly
in a way that makes fun of someone
